title: A Website Opportunities demo build sweeps template leftovers (text, prices, post dates, links, pictures, logo) after the agent's turn without removing anything, page leads must be written by the agent, and a brief without logo research asks for it once without any request waiting
steps: S1: From the TCH checkout run: node --test --test-reporter=tap apps/tracy-web/test/wo-residue-sweep.test.mjs apps/tracy-web/test/wo-logo-research.test.mjs packages/tools/tracy-site-tools/test/sweep-resolve.test.mjs
S2: Read the exit code, the `# pass`, `# fail`, `# skipped` and `# cancelled` lines and the tests named below.
expect: S1 exits 0 with 0 failures, 0 skipped, 0 cancelled.
'nothing is removed: no call deletes, hides or unpublishes' and 'a site already swept plans nothing' pass.

'lr-now: every template dish takes its neutral item name, its price and its description are left empty', 'a sweep of a dish with no price and a line with no fact writes no filler: every replacement is empty or neutral' and 'lr-now: a template post date becomes the build day on the post itself' pass.
'an image row on a post's body writes the picture only: the template's prose is still swept, once' passes.

'a card's line under its title is the card's, never a page lead: a card class, or a grid of same-shaped boxes' and 'with no sourced line in the research, a missed lead is left empty and the plan counts it as thin' pass.

'a brief with no logo research asks for it once, answers pending at once, and builds from the place read again' and 'a refused logo research never stops the build: it goes on, and the check names the refusal' pass.

'the sweep's neutral wording is in the site's language: Vietnamese words on a Vietnamese site, English for Danish' and 'a heading or a link the sweep would empty takes the neutral wording of its role; a list item, with no role, is named unresolved' pass.

'a word inside a heading is the heading's: `h2 > span` and `h3 > strong > em` take the neutral heading on WordPress, Joomla and EmDash', 'a linked title is a title, never a contact label nor the neutral heading: with no sourced title it is unresolved, no call planned' and 'a slot the replace job refuses to empty is never sent empty: a list item, a tag link and a button with no Contact page are unresolved with the reason' pass.

'the page reader names the tags holding a text past the selector's two, so a deep heading and a card's linked heading read as such' and 'the sweep reads the replace job's own cannot-empty list: the Dockerfile ships site-tools' leaf where the sweep looks, and it imports alone' pass.

'read by the page reader, filler inside a heading or a list item knows its slot: `

Coming soon

` takes the neutral heading, `
  • Sample
    • ` is unresolved, on WordPress, Joomla and EmDash', 'every residue kind reaches the sweep with the block its words sit in: filler, a dish, a price and a date carry it as the template text does', 'a contact fact with no sourced value is never given neutral wording: `+1 555 123 4567` in `h2 > span` is unresolved, and in a paragraph it is left empty' and 'the neutral heading stands only for template words: a price filling a whole heading is unresolved, never "Overview", on WordPress, Joomla and EmDash' pass.
evidence: The Willow Nook cafe demo on JA Diner WP (24/10/2026): template dishes with $ prices, 'Sample'/'Ask' labels, 2021 post dates, stock photos, buttons to the wrong page and the template logo stayed after the agent's turn; the /blog/ banner lead read 'Coming soon' instead of copy written from research.
fence: Mechanism only: the planner, the logo-research state machine and the dsh resolver over fixtures. Not covered: the database path that carries an unresolved-only sweep to the check (website-opportunities-demo-runner, needs TEST_DATABASE_URL), a live build on a real site, Joomla and EmDash live runs, and what the model writes.
